summary: Iteration 130: Prelaunch checklist sections 2.6 (Artwork/Files/Drawings), 2.7 (Webstores remaining), 2.8 (Products CRUD), 2.9 (Questionnaires), 2.10 (Customer Signature Page). 37/37 tests passed (100%). 5 notable design findings documented below.

minor.issue: 2.7-A: Webstore name uniqueness NOT enforced. Two webstores with identical names can be created (no uniqueness check on name or slug). Both POST calls return 200 with different IDs.

2.7-F: SEO/OG fields (seo_title, seo_description, og_image, meta_description) are ABSENT from the storefront response. WEBSTORE_PUBLIC_FIELDS list only includes: id, name, store_type, owner_name, description, status, is_public, branding, fundraiser_goal, fundraiser_start_date, fundraiser_end_date, total_sales, total_orders. No SEO metadata is implemented.

2.7-G: Product model uses extra='ignore'. Fields size_options, color_options, is_featured, in_stock are silently dropped on create/update/retrieve. They are NOT stored in MongoDB and NOT returned on GET. Checklist specifies testing these fields but they are not in the Product model.

2.9-G: Email format validation is NOT enforced for questionnaire answer fields. The submit endpoint stores answers as Dict[str,Any] without per-field type/format validation. Submitting 'not-an-email' in an email-type question returns 200 (accepted). Only required-field presence is validated.

2.10-B: The request_token is NEVER returned by any API endpoint. /requirement strips it (signature.pop('request_token', None)) before returning. /request returns only {message, signature_id, expires_at}. The token is only deliverable via email. For programmatic testing, token must be retrieved directly from MongoDB. This may be intentional for security but makes testing difficult and customer token delivery email-only.

action_items: DECISION 2.7-A: Decide whether webstore name uniqueness should be enforced. Currently no constraint exists — two stores can have identical names/slugs. If uniqueness is desired, add a unique index on {tenant_id, name} in webstores_v2 collection.

FEATURE 2.7-F: SEO/OG fields (seo_title, seo_description, og_image, meta_description) are not implemented in the Webstore model or storefront endpoint. Add to Webstore model and WEBSTORE_PUBLIC_FIELDS list if SEO meta tags are desired.

CLARIFY 2.7-G: Product model extra='ignore' silently drops size_options, color_options, is_featured, in_stock. If these product attributes are needed, add them to ProductCreate/ProductUpdate/Product models.

CLARIFY 2.9 field types: The valid QuestionType enum values are text/textarea/number/email/phone/select/multi_select/radio/checkbox/date/file_upload/signature/heading/paragraph. The checklist mentions 'short_text','long_text','multiple_choice','dropdown' — update documentation/checklist to use valid enum values.
DESIGN NOTE 2.9-G: Questionnaire submit does not validate email format in answer fields. Consider adding format validation for email-type questions at submission time.

DESIGN NOTE 2.10-B: The request_token is never returned by any API endpoint (stripped in /requirement, not included in /request response). The only way for customers to get their signing URL is via email. If a 'resend link' or 'copy link' feature is needed for the dashboard, an endpoint to retrieve/refresh the public signing URL should be added.
critical_code_review_comments: MEDIUM: No webstore name uniqueness enforcement. Users could accidentally create duplicate stores with same name. Consider unique index on {tenant_id, name} in webstores_v2.
LOW: Product model uses extra='ignore' causing size_options/color_options/is_featured/in_stock to be silently dropped. If these are future-planned fields, add them now to avoid confusion.
LOW: Questionnaire submit does not validate email/phone field answer format — answers are stored as raw Dict[str,Any]. Consider format validation hooks per QuestionType.

INFO: Signature request_token has no API retrieval path after creation. The only delivery mechanism is email via /request endpoint. Consider adding a 'get-signing-url' endpoint for admins to retrieve or resend the token/link.

INFO: Drawing file endpoint (GET /order-drawings/file/{id}) has NO authentication — any user with a drawing_id can download the file. This appears intentional but is worth documenting as a security consideration.
